newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet to upgrade Minnesota paper machine.
newsitem.headline: Valmet to upgrade Minnesota paper machine.

text.p: Finnish paper machinery group Valmet Oy said on Thursday it had sealed a deal with Blandin Paper, a unit of Fletcher Challenge Co. Ltd, for the modernisation of a magazine paper machine in Minnesota for an undisclosed sum.
"The modernisation will raise the capacity of the Grand Rapids mill to 517,000 tonnes per year," Valmet said in a statement.
The value of the deal was not disclosed at the customer's request, a Valmet spokesman said.
"But an order like this is typically worth 50 to 100 million markka," he added.

In November, Fletcher's unit Fletcher Challenge Canada Ltd said it was planning a $32 million upgrade of a paper machine at its Blandin unit that would raise output of ultra-lightweight catalogue paper by 42,000 tonnes a year.
The start-up of the rebuilt machine is scheduled for March 1998, Valmet said.
